name: upsert_memory_node
description: Create or update a memory node in the linking graph. Nodes represent concepts, files, symbols, or notes with auto-generated embeddings. If a node with the same label and type exists, it updates content and increments access count. Returns the node ID for use in create_relation.

type.description: Node type: concept (abstract ideas), file (source files), symbol (functions/classes), note (free-form).

label.description: Short identifier for the node. Used for deduplication with type.

content.description: Detailed content for the node. Used for embedding generation.
